title: Driver hatch: ordinary opening, source roof exit and physical jump back into the driver seat
input_audit: Initial driver station is ordinary scenario setup. H uses TankInput.hatch_toggle for the occupied post; dismount calls the same can_climb_out/climb_out path as the live exit. No on_foot, foot_xz, hatch_open, mount or station-change injection is used. The soldier's normal initial yaw faces negative Z. After the source exit selects the supported point 0.52 m forward of the hatch, twelve ordinary W ticks move approximately 0.55 m toward the aperture during a real Space jump. Gravity and the source collision/entry code must return him to Driver. If a different exit support is selected, this fixed input script must fail and its path be inspected rather than reposition the soldier.
visual_acceptance: Opening rotates the complete original driver hatch and its eyepiece.
At 1.2-2.2 seconds the soldier stands on the exterior roof, with a normal human eye above his feet.
The 2.25-second jump rises and descends through the open driver aperture; there is no pass through solid armor or scripted mount action.
After returning to Driver, H closes that same hatch and its attached periscope.
